title: Laptop cannot connect to Wi-Fi
symptoms: Laptop Wi-Fi cannot connect but other devices work. Wireless network disconnected.
solution_steps: Confirm Wi-Fi is enabled and airplane mode is off.
Check the selected network name and move closer to the access point.
Disconnect and reconnect using your own known network credentials; never share them.
Save your work and restart the laptop if safe. Contact IT if the issue persists.

title: Connected to Wi-Fi with no internet
symptoms: Wi-Fi connected but websites will not load; internet unavailable.
solution_steps: Try a second trusted website and check whether another device is affected.
Check the organization's service status page using an alternative connection.
If multiple devices are affected, report the outage to IT with time and location.

title: VPN connection fails
symptoms: VPN remote access connection fails or times out.
solution_steps: Confirm normal internet access works before connecting to VPN.
Check the VPN service status and verify the approved client is up to date.
Record the error code and contact IT; do not disable security software.

title: Application crashes on launch
symptoms: Software application app crashes freezes or closes unexpectedly.
solution_steps: Save other work and close the affected application normally.
Reopen it and record the exact error message.
Check for updates through the approved software portal and contact IT if crashes continue.

title: Software installation needs approval
symptoms: Cannot install software application; admin permission required.
solution_steps: Check whether the application is available in the approved company software portal.
Record the software name, version and business need.
Request IT approval; do not bypass administrator restrictions.

title: Browser page fails to load
symptoms: Browser website slow blank page loading error.
solution_steps: Confirm the URL is correct and try a second trusted site.
Try an approved alternative browser or a private window.
Record the error and contact IT if it affects business applications.

title: External monitor has no display
symptoms: External monitor black screen no display no signal.
solution_steps: Check the monitor power indicator and selected input source.
Inspect accessible display cable connections without opening equipment.
Use the operating system display settings to detect the monitor; report persistent issues to IT.

title: Printer does not print
symptoms: Printer offline print job stuck cannot print documents.
solution_steps: Verify the correct printer is selected and check its visible status panel.
Check paper and accessible covers according to the printer instructions.
Record the error and contact IT; do not open electrical components or remove others' jobs.

title: Battery overheating or swelling
symptoms: Laptop battery hot overheating swollen burning smell smoke.
solution_steps: Stop using the laptop and do not charge it.
Keep clear of a damaged battery; do not puncture it, open the laptop or attempt repair.
Contact IT immediately; use emergency services if there is smoke or immediate danger.

title: Password not accepted
symptoms: Login sign in password incorrect account access denied.
solution_steps: Check the username, keyboard layout and Caps Lock without sharing the password.
Use the official password reset page reached through a trusted bookmark.
Avoid repeated attempts and contact IT if the account is locked.

title: MFA prompt not received
symptoms: MFA multi factor authentication code push not received login.
solution_steps: Check the registered authenticator device has connectivity and correct time.
Use an approved recovery method if one was previously configured.
Contact IT for identity verification; never share one-time codes or approve unexpected prompts.

title: Account locked after failed logins
symptoms: Account locked login failed too many password attempts.
solution_steps: Stop repeated sign-in attempts.
Check the organization's account recovery guidance from a trusted portal.
Contact IT to verify your identity and investigate repeated lockouts.

title: Email not sending or receiving
symptoms: Email Outlook mailbox cannot send receive messages stuck outbox.
solution_steps: Check your internet connection and the mail service status.
Check whether approved webmail works and note any delivery error code.
Contact IT with the error and timestamp, excluding confidential message content.

title: Suspicious phishing email
symptoms: Phishing suspicious email link attachment unexpected credential request.
solution_steps: Do not open links or attachments and do not reply.
Report the message using the approved phishing reporting channel.
If you already interacted, contact IT security immediately using a known trusted channel.

title: Email attachment exceeds size limit
symptoms: Email large attachment file size exceeds limit cannot send.
solution_steps: Check the attachment size and the mail service's documented limit.
Use the organization's approved file sharing service with intended-recipient access.
Confirm permissions before sharing and ask IT if delivery still fails.

title: Gather useful troubleshooting information
symptoms: Unknown issue intermittent problem support request information.
solution_steps: Record the affected device, application, exact error and time the issue began.
Note recent changes and whether other users are affected.
Share these observations with IT, excluding passwords and confidential data.

title: Slow computer performance
symptoms: Computer laptop slow performance many applications freezes.
solution_steps: Save your work and close applications you no longer need.
Check the operating system's built-in activity monitor for resource usage.
Restart when safe and contact IT if persistent; do not delete system files or disable protection.

title: Keyboard or mouse not responding
symptoms: Keyboard mouse USB input not responding disconnected.
solution_steps: Check accessible cable connections or the device's battery indicator.
Try another available USB port if safe and allowed.
Record which devices work and contact IT if the issue persists.
